# Adi Agarwal

> Product manager with an analytics background: e-commerce, advertising, supply chains and food delivery. Now at Northwestern, M.S. Engineering Design Innovation.

Adi Agarwal (Aditya Agarwal) is a product manager who builds what he designs: AI agents, connected hardware, 3D interfaces and data products. He worked as a product and data analyst at Zomato, Udaan and Snapdeal, and is studying for an M.S. in Engineering Design Innovation at Northwestern University.

Contact: https://www.linkedin.com/in/adiind · Resume: https://adidesign.org/Adi_Agarwal_Resume_2026.pdf

## Projects

- [Glyph: A Body for AI](https://adidesign.org/work/glyph): I built a wearable test bed to see what happens when AI leaves the chat window and becomes something you can wear, move, and build on.
- [P&G · Hair Care Product Packaging](https://adidesign.org/work/pg-haircare): Rethinking the bottle, and the routine around it.
- [Zero: Second Brain AI Assistant](https://adidesign.org/work/zero-my-ai): Zero talks, chats, remembers people and projects, helps me code, generates images, and turns bugs and feature ideas into a build loop.
- [FamilySync – Agentic family coordination with JPMorgan Chase](https://adidesign.org/work/familysync-jpmorgan): An agent that coordinates a family when a child's day changes. It does the legwork; a person approves every handoff.
- [Squad Up — group ordering for McDonald’s](https://adidesign.org/work/mcdonalds-interaction-design): Group ordering across shared digital touchpoints
- [Surya: Kinetic Wall Timepiece](https://adidesign.org/work/surya): A kinetic wall-mounted timepiece that represents my family across global time zones, opening and closing as they wake and sleep.
- [SoloPump: One-Handed Liquid Dispenser](https://adidesign.org/work/solopump): An automated drink dispensing machine that pours measured drinks or shots, with manual control and a web interface to adjust output.
- [Helios: Mechanical Kinetic Lamp](https://adidesign.org/work/helios): A 3D-printed lamp. Turn the ring by hand and eight spur gears change the light.
- [Jarvis: Voice-Controlled Smart Home Assistant](https://adidesign.org/work/jarvis): A voice assistant I built for my home. Walk up and it wakes.
- [Plotter: Speech-to-Draw Machine](https://adidesign.org/work/plotter): A DIY plotter that turns spoken words into plotted drawings by converting speech to text, then text to vector strokes and G-code.
- [Portfolio Website](https://adidesign.org/work/portfolio-website): This site. I build it with AI coding agents: Antigravity, Codex and Claude.

## Experience

- [AI Product Manager (Intern), Self](https://adidesign.org/experience/self-xyz): Worked across product thinking and hands-on development with engineers on multi-step agentic products, exploring how capable AI workflows can stay understandable and user-directed.
- [Portfolio V2, Personal Project](https://adidesign.org/experience/portfolio-website): Building this portfolio with agentic coding workflows.
- [MS Engineering Design Innovation, Northwestern University | Segal Design Institute](https://adidesign.org/experience/ms-edi): Learning to decide what is worth building, and how to make it real across partner-led systems, services, and interaction design work.
- [Senior Product Analyst, Zomato](https://adidesign.org/experience/zomato): Analytics for the home screen of India's largest food delivery app.
- [Jarvis Assistant, Top 10 Finalist · ASEAN-wide Edge AI & IoT Challenge](https://adidesign.org/experience/jarvis-competition): Top-10 DIY voice-recognition home assistant built with Maixduino and MQTT.
- [Product Analyst, Udaan](https://adidesign.org/experience/udaan): Built analytics and decision systems across supply chain, marketplace, and product at national scale.
- [Product and Growth Analyst, Schmooze](https://adidesign.org/experience/schmooze): Pre-PMF analytics at a seed-stage dating app exploring meme-based matching.
- [Data Analyst · Ads & Supply Infrastructure, Snapdeal](https://adidesign.org/experience/snapdeal): Building ads analytics and supply infrastructure during Snapdeal's first-party transition.
- [Creator, Tinker Verse](https://adidesign.org/experience/tinkerverse): Personal lab for physical computing, agentic software, and expressive prototypes.
- [B.E. Civil Engineering + M.Sc. Biological Sciences, BITS Pilani, Hyderabad Campus](https://adidesign.org/experience/bits): Interdisciplinary academic training combined with hands-on leadership across technical, biological, and student-led initiatives.
